api.name: get_trade_call
api.description: Returns a composite verdict — BUY SELL HOLD trade call with confidence and market regime — for one crypto or tokenized-stock perpetual futures. One asset only; whole-market scan: scan_trade_calls. Read-only: live exchange APIs, no orders. Verified track record: get_track_record or performance://signal-performance; on-chain verified merkle anchor.

coin.description: Asset — BTC ETH SOL signal for crypto perpetual futures or TradFi symbol.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe (1m to 1d) for crypto quant agents. Default 15m intraday.

includeReasoning.description: Include reasoning for the trade call verdict (regime, trend ranging signals).

api.name: get_trade_signal
api.description: Returns a composite verdict — BUY SELL HOLD trade call with confidence and market regime — for one crypto or tokenized-stock perpetual futures. One asset only; whole-market scan: scan_trade_calls. Read-only: live exchange APIs, no orders. Verified track record: get_track_record or performance://signal-performance; on-chain verified merkle anchor. [ALIAS] This tool is an alias of get_trade_call — same behavior, kept for backward compatibility. Prefer get_trade_call for new integrations.

coin.description: Asset — BTC ETH SOL signal for crypto perpetual futures or TradFi symbol.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe (1m to 1d) for crypto quant agents. Default 15m intraday.

includeReasoning.description: Include reasoning for the trade call verdict (regime, trend ranging signals).

api.name: scan_funding_arb
api.description: Ranked cross-venue funding arbitrage across major crypto perpetual futures venues — funding rate spreads, long one venue short another, as a BUY SELL HOLD composite verdict per pair. AI trading signal for crypto quant and Claude trading agents. Trade call via get_trade_call, market regime via get_market_regime. On-chain verified merkle anchor.

minSpreadBps.description: Minimum funding rate spread (bps) for buy sell hold trade call cross-venue scan.

limit.description: Max funding arbitrage results returned (free tier cap 5). Crypto signal query.

api.name: get_market_regime
api.description: Returns the market regime — TRENDING_UP TRENDING_DOWN RANGING VOLATILE — with confidence and a strategy hint, for one crypto perpetual futures. Composite verdict: trend ranging + cross-venue funding rate. Read-only, live exchange APIs. Verified track record: get_track_record or performance://signal-performance; on-chain verified merkle anchor.

coin.description: Asset symbol — BTC ETH SOL signal. Crypto quant trade call classification.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe — 1h 4h 1d. Buy sell hold regime context for AI trading signal.

exchange.description: Exchange BINANCE HL BYBIT OKX BITGET. Multi-exchange Claude trading agent.

api.name: search_knowledge
api.description: Returns ranked snippets from the AlgoVault knowledge bundle answering a question about its MCP tools, response shapes, integration patterns (LangChain, LlamaIndex, MAF, CrewAI), or code examples. Call this BEFORE other tool calls to confirm parameter usage and avoid hallucinating tool shapes. Fast: BM25 lexical search, no LLM call, no quota cost. For a synthesized natural-language answer use chat_knowledge. Read-only, no side effects.

api.name: chat_knowledge
api.description: Returns a synthesized natural-language answer with citations, grounded in the AlgoVault knowledge bundle (every MCP tool description, response shape, integration tutorial, and code example). Use when you need an explanation, code pattern, or how-to; for raw ranked snippets without LLM synthesis use search_knowledge (faster, no quota cost). Read-only: calls an LLM, no other side effects. Quota: Free 10/month, Starter 50, Pro 200, Enterprise 2000.

api.name: scan_trade_calls
api.description: Returns ranked BUY SELL HOLD trade calls across the top crypto perpetual futures by open interest — one scan for whole-market coverage, each with confidence and market regime. Use this for breadth; use get_trade_call for per-coin depth and reasoning. Read-only: reads live exchange APIs, places no orders.

topN.description: Scan the top-N perps by open interest (1-100, default 20). Whole-market scan.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe (1m to 1d) for the scan. Default 15m intraday.

exchange.description: Venue: BINANCE (default) HL BYBIT OKX BITGET — top perps by open interest.

minConfidence.description: Optional min confidence (0-100) filter applied to non-HOLD trade calls.

includeHolds.description: Include HOLD calls after non-HOLD (default false).

limit.description: Max ranked calls returned (1-100, default 10). Non-HOLD ranked first.

api.name: scan_market_regimes
api.description: Screens a whole crypto perpetual futures venue by market regime — TRENDING_UP TRENDING_DOWN RANGING VOLATILE — and returns each matching coin with confidence, trend strength, ADX, volatility ratio and how long the regime has held. Rows are the market regime classifier output for the last closed bar, sampled on Binance, Bybit, OKX and Bitget; another venue, or a timeframe a venue cannot serve, is refused with the alternatives. Billing: one call per returned row; non-matching coins are free. For a live single-coin read with cross-venue funding, call get_market_regime. Read-only.

exchange.description: Venue to screen (default Binance). A venue outside the sampled set is refused with the sampled list.

regime.description: Keep only these regimes (any of): TRENDING_UP, TRENDING_DOWN, RANGING, VOLATILE.

maxRegimeAgeBars.description: Keep only coins whose regime began within this many bars (1 = changed on the last closed bar). Coins whose regime start is not yet known are excluded.

assetClass.description: all (default), crypto, tradfi (every non-crypto class), equity, commodity, index, fx or premarket.

minLiquidityUsd.description: Optional USD liquidity floor applied to the scan universe: notional open interest, or 24h volume on venues that expose no bulk OI. Omitted means no floor.

coins.description: Restrict to these symbols, e.g. ["BTC","ETH"]. Symbols not on the venue are listed in not_found and not billed.

rankBy.description: Optional universe lens — the same lenses and aliases as scan_trade_calls rankBy; rows then echo the lens metric. Omit to screen every coin.

topN.description: Lens universe size, 1 to 1000 (default 100 with rankBy). Without rankBy it selects the top coins by open interest.

oiChangeWindow.description: OI-delta window for rankBy=oi_change: 1h, 4h, or 24h (default 24h). Ignored by other lenses.

oiBasis.description: OI-delta basis for rankBy=oi_change: notional (default, USD) or contracts (base-coin, price-independent). Ignored by other lenses.

sortBy.description: confidence (default), regime_age (most recent regime change first, unknown starts last), or rank (lens order; needs rankBy).

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging within one snapshot. A changed as_of means the snapshot advanced between pages.

api.name: pre_trade_check
api.description: Returns a pre-trade check of a crypto perpetual futures order against your own rules: each passes or fails with its numbers, then GO, CAUTION or WAIT. Adds isolated liquidation distance, whether it hits before your stop, fees, accuracy needed to break even over your hold, funding by venue (cross-venue) and the regime. Read-only: places no orders.

coin.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL.

side.description: Direction of the order you intend to place: long or short.

holdHours.description: Expected holding time in hours (default 8); sets the funding cost window.

exchanges.description: Only compare these venues (default: every supported venue).

leverage.description: Isolated leverage you will use, e.g. 10. Enables the liquidation checks.

stopPct.description: Stop-loss distance from entry in percent, e.g. 2.

targetPct.description: Target distance from entry in percent, e.g. 4.

equityUsd.description: Account equity in USD. Enables the percent-of-equity rules.

orderType.description: market (taker entry) or limit (maker entry). Default market.

noLiqBeforeStop.description: Fail if liquidation would come before your stop. Default on.

minLiqDistanceSigma.description: Liquidation at least this many hold-period volatilities away.

maxLossAtStopPctEquity.description: Most equity, in percent, you accept losing at your stop.

maxDailyMovePctEquity.description: Largest equity swing, in percent, from a one-sigma daily move.

maxRoundTripBps.description: Highest round trip in fees plus spread, in bps.

maxAccuracyNeededPct.description: Highest direction accuracy, in percent, needed to break even.

maxFundingBps.description: Highest funding over the hold, in bps. Default 10.

maxSizePctOf24hVolume.description: Largest order as a percent of a venue's 24h volume. Default 0.1.

regimeCheck.description: Flag a regime against your side or a volatile one. Default on.

rules.description: Your rules, each key optional. A rule of yours that fails returns WAIT.
